content.title: Sidi Abdallah State-Sponsored Housing — 200 Homes
summary: 200 state-sponsored housing units delivered within the wider 1,200-home Sidi Abdallah urban development, integrating high-density R+9 residential blocks with ground-floor commercial and professional premises.
The secondary trades and interior fit-out scope was executed for F3 and F4 apartment layouts, coordinated to meet the master plan's structural and spatial constraints.
description: The construction scope focused on secondary trades and interior fit-out works for the dense R+9 residential blocks. Facade articulation, internal circulation cores, and technical building services were coordinated to align with the wider master plan.

Ground-floor commercial and professional spaces integrated beneath the residential massing establish a mixed-use street profile that supports local economic activity within the new urban district. Completed in 2022.
content.authority: A state-sponsored housing delivery where secondary trades, service premises, and R+9 residential density work together to support a new urban district.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Sidi Abdallah housing project?
faq.answer: 200 state-sponsored housing units delivered within a larger 1,200-home urban development in Sidi Abdallah, featuring R+9 residential blocks with ground-floor commercial spaces. Completed 2022.

faq.question: What construction works were executed on this site?
faq.answer: The contract covered secondary trades and interior fit-out works for the R+9 residential blocks, excluding the primary site roads and utility networks package.

faq.question: How are the residential buildings configured?
faq.answer: Buildings are ground floor plus 9 upper floors (R+9), housing F3 and F4 apartment layouts. Ground-floor levels accommodate commercial and professional premises integrated into the street frontage.
